fields.description: Each company has one Share Accounting Settings record.
fields.label: Company

fields.description:
Direct: the Payment Entry is created and submitted when you submit the Share Transaction.
Clearing: the amount stays in the Clearing Account. Accounts creates the Payment Entry later with Create > Payment Entry.
fields.label: Accounting Mode

fields.description: Accounts that receive or pay the money for a Share Transaction.
fields.label: Settlement Accounts

fields.description: Share Transactions post the amount to this account. The Payment Entry then moves the amount between this account and the bank or cash account.
fields.label: Clearing Account

fields.description: Pre-fills the Bank or Cash Account on Share Transactions. You can change it on each transaction.
fields.label: Default Bank or Cash Account

fields.description: Default equity accounts for Share Transactions. You can change them on each Share Transaction before you submit it.
fields.label: Equity Accounts

fields.description: Credited with the face value on Issue. Debited with the face value on Retirement.
fields.label: Share Capital Account

fields.description: Credited with the amount above the face value on Issue.
fields.label: Securities Premium Account

fields.description: Debited with the buyback cost. Credited with the treasury cost on Reissue or Retirement.
fields.label: Treasury Shares Account

fields.description: Records the difference between the treasury cost and the reissue price, or between the treasury cost and the face value on Retirement. Use an equity account: this difference does not go to Profit and Loss.
fields.label: Treasury Gain / Loss Account
